Provenance: Forgejo original source identity experiment for issue #275

Provider: Forgejo 16.0.3+gitea-1.22.0, CI-owned disposable service.
Source: Woodpecker repository 29, pipeline 797, workflow 12641,
step 48211; PR #276 head 51340492ebd3ada45be3abc55d35e602394db998.
https://git.dev.adlevio.net/tokarix/forge-mcp/pulls/276
http://woodpecker.dev.adlevio.net/repos/29/pipeline/797/2

The adjacent JSON contains all 11 SOURCE_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE records and
all four SOURCE_IDENTITY_GROUND_TRUTH records from that successful step.
Records were retrieved through the gateway's bounded plain-text download
reader. Capture code allowlists only PR state/number/merged and head/base
ref, label, sha, repo_id, and repository id/name/full_name/owner login/id.
Body, title, clone URLs, credentials and unrelated user details are excluded.
CI-generated names, IDs and SHAs are retained verbatim; absent keys and
explicit nulls retain their different shapes. No production PR was mutated.

Lifecycle and interpretation:
- PR 1: known branch evidence/closed/Case+λ; open, closed with retained
  source branch, then closed with source branch deleted and GET returning
  404. PR 2 repeats the lifecycle with a merge. PR 3 is an open control.
- PR 4: source repository is a fork owned by a distinct CI organization.
  Creation uses a qualified owner:branch request head. Captures cover open,
  closed, deleted branch and finally deleted source repository (verified
  unreadable). Cleanup removes the remaining repositories, organization
  and ephemeral token even after lifecycle failures.
- For all four PRs, head.label equals the exact branch supplied at fixture
  creation, including slash, case, plus and Unicode. List and detail agree.
  This version's response label is UNQUALIFIED, including for the fork.
  No delimiter grammar or qualified-response-label recovery is established.
- After branch deletion, head.ref becomes refs/pull/<number>/head while
  head.label retains the original branch; head.repo and repo_id still
  identify the source repository independently of the target.
- After source repository deletion, head.label survives but head.repo is
  null and head.repo_id is -1. That shape cannot establish a complete
  source identity and must remain unknown. Never substitute the base repo.

Evidence boundary:
This fixture proves provider behavior for these CI-created inputs on this
version. It does not prove behavior on a deployed gateway, retention on
other versions, or recovery for ambiguous/missing metadata. Production
normalization and adapter/schema/transport regressions remain separate work.
The historical Cockpit PR #470 has not been read through a corrected gateway.
